exposure: fentanyl combined with flurbiprofen axetil and antiemetic
sufentanil combined with flurbiprofen axetil and antiemetic
butorphanol combined with flurbiprofen axetil and antiemetic
cohort: 463 patients who underwent a cesarean delivery at Shenzhen Second People's Hospital between January 2022 and October 2023.
finding: Different postoperative patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) formulae show similar analgesic effects following cesarean delivery, though butorphanol causes fewer postoperative nausea and vomiting incidences compared to fentanyl and sufentanil.
